chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
And [granted] to those who are pious, but He makes it over those who take him as a master and choose him as allies.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Satan's authority over the faithful versus those who follow him?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) clarification that Satan’s *sultan* (authority/power) is not absolute but conditional, rooted in the Quranic verse 'He has no authority over those who believe' (14:22). This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle that spiritual autonomy (*wilayah*) allows the faithful to transcend satanic influence, while those who align with his whispers fall under his specific dominion.
